contexts: Four nested count tables: global; exact hour/weekend/quarter; current volume bin/hour divided by three/weekend; arm-specific conjunction. current_exact uses exact current volume and full clock. current_weather uses current volume bin/full clock plus weather/holiday bins. temporal_pair adds clipped 1-hour and 3-hour volume increments to current_weather. histogram replaces increments with sorted three prior volume bins. reversed reverses only prior samples, preserving current sample/weather/clock. Each posterior is (positive_count + 8 * parent_probability)/(count + 8), starting at 0.5. No averaging of independent historical marginal probabilities.
delay: Predict at cutoff; release result at cutoff+1h before another same-time prediction. Train only on due outcomes; development frozen. The virtual row-time schedule does not certify physical sensor publication time.
duplicates: Collapse identical hourly numeric traffic/weather/holiday observations, union sorted weather categories. If numeric or holiday cells disagree, exclude that whole hour. Date/time admission precedes all numeric cells. Empty, missing, conflicting or invalid hours never supply negative outcomes.
scope: A fresh one-shot development screen, not proof of unconditional temporal necessity or spike-specific benefit. Quantized-current contrasts are descriptive, not causal matched trials. Full timestamp calendar is available to current controls. Preserve all older negative artifacts and sealed periods. Never decode 2017-onward traffic/weather values, even for support counts. Minimum support failure stops before learner scoring. Six learned arms have four changed counter increments per feedback; persistence is an untrained reference with zero updates, explicitly separate. Retain day-level uncertainty and prediction/count checkpoint replay; no retuning on this development split. No matrix, GPU or network-wide gradients. No synthetic learner retry; analytical input/local-branch unit checks only.
